theme: Light theme (Organic & Earthy). Calm jade/sage green with ivory. Avoid standard SaaS appearance.

rules.hanzi_display: text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-serif text-[#4A6B53] mb-2 leading-tight

components.meridian_card: bg-surface rounded-3xl p-8 border border-border/50 hover:-translate-y-1 transition-all duration-300 shadow-[0_4px_24px_rgba(74,107,83,0.06)] hover:shadow-[0_12px_32px_rgba(74,107,83,0.12)] flex flex-col justify-between cursor-pointer group
components.point_card: bg-surface rounded-2xl p-6 mb-4 flex flex-row items-center justify-between border border-border/30 shadow-sm transition-colors hover:border-[#A3B19B]/50
components.audio_button: idle: bg-[#A3B19B]/10 text-[#4A6B53] hover:bg-[#4A6B53] hover:text-white rounded-full p-4 transition-all duration-300. active: bg-[#C87964] text-white ring-4 ring-[#C87964]/30 animate-pulse.
components.sticky_header: sticky top-0 z-50 bg-[#FDFBF7]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-[#E2E7DE] px-4 py-4 sm:px-8 sm:py-6

layouts.homepage: Mobile-first standard flow. Container max-w-5xl mx-auto px-4 py-16 sm:py-24. Use CSS Grid: grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-8.
layouts.detail_page: Single column narrow layout for focused reading. max-w-3xl mx-auto px-4 pb-24 pt-8.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure WCAG AA contrast. Text colors must be #233127 against #FDFBF7.
accessibility.test_ids: Add data-testid='meridian-card-[code]', data-testid='point-card-[code]', data-testid='audio-button-[code]' to elements.

instructions_to_main_agent.localization: UI must use Bahasa Indonesia. E.g., '14 Meridian TCM', 'Kembali' for back button.
instructions_to_main_agent.audio_fallback: Use sonner toast for errors: 'Audio tidak tersedia di perangkat ini'.
instructions_to_main_agent.speech_api: Use window.speechSynthesis with 'zh-CN' lang. Bind state to audio button to show visual feedback (pulse) when speaking.
instructions_to_main_agent.data_population: Include all standard points for the 14 meridians. Hardcode the data structure cleanly in a separate file (e.g., data/meridians.js).

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: NEVER use generic 'AI slop' gradients or pure generic blue. Use the provided organic earthy palette.
Do not center align the app container. No .App { text-align: center; }.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Allow the typography (Hanzi) to breathe.
Do not use complete transparent background in header. Use backdrop-blur-xl with bg-[#FDFBF7]/80.
